_readme: Copy to firm_rules.json (kept out of git). Every account is a TEST account unless listed under 'accounts' as challenge, funded or live. Firm figures are examples; confirm them against each account's terms.

FTMO.notes: Standard 2-step challenge figures. Daily reset follows FTMO's day boundary (midnight CE(S)T); the EA uses the broker-server day, which normally lines up. Confirm against your account dashboard.

FTUK.notes: Fill from the program you bought; FTUK rules vary by program.

BlueGuardian.notes: Instant funding account. Fill from its terms; check whether max loss trails equity or balance.

PTB.notes: TradeLocker accounts won't run the MT5 heartbeat; listed for completeness.

LiteFinance.notes: Broker account, no firm limits. Internal buffer only.
